title: MCP health check reads a multi-megabyte tools/list reply
objective: Add src/wev_skills/third_party/health.py with health(source: Source, version: str, root: Path, runner: SubprocessRunner, *, npx: str) -> HealthReport. For the rea MCP source it starts the executable named by npx with arguments `-y rea-agents@<version> mcp`; the child inherits the parent's environment variables as they are. It speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC over the child's stdio: send initialize and read its reply, send notifications/initialized, then send tools/list and read the reply, one JSON object per line. It returns HealthReport(ok, code, params) where ok is True with params["tools"] set to the number of tools listed. A tools/list reply can list thousands of tools; the report must still be ok.
